sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing a stylized Earth with geographic and
magnetic poles offset. Field-line overlay rendered as dipole
streamlines. Draggable "compass" test object placed on the surface:
shows local B̄ arrow with two readouts — declinaison (angle to
geographic north) and inclinaison (angle to horizontal). Slider
adjusts observer latitude. Experiment: match a target inclinaison
by moving the compass to the right latitude. Evaluate: field-line
overlay hidden; student predicts declinaison + inclinaison at a
marked location, then reveals. Wrinkle: uses simple centered-dipole
model; no secular variation.
